{{Quote|Our biggest, most stacked slider! Piled high with two patties, triple cheese, deep-fried Tapani triangles, mega-leaf lettuce, a slice of algae-bread, Boontaspiced mustard, plankton spread, larded neutrinos and a fried blubberbird egg, with a green jumbolive on top, it's just the thing to satisfy a Herglic-sized hunger.|Dex's Diner menu, on the Giju slider|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
A '''fried blubberbird egg''' was a type of [[Egg/Legends|egg]] [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] made from the [[Blubberbird egg|eggs]] of the [[blubberbird]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Fried blubberbird eggs were used by the [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] to make the [[giju slider]]s that he served at his [[Dex's Diner/Legends|diner]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fried blubberbird eggs were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
